name: Echo-Bark Trunks
introDiscord:
Hollow echo-bark trunks rise between the kelp like drowned trees. Every
tap, laugh, footstep, and bubble returns seconds later from somewhere
else in the forest.
introTwitch:
Hollow echo-bark trunks rise between the kelp like drowned trees. Every
tap, laugh, footstep, and bubble returns seconds later from somewhere
else in the forest.

echo-bark-trunks-approach.prompt:
Three routes pass between enormous hollow trunks. Your last footstep
echoes from a direction you never walked.

left.message:
Restorative sap rests inside a hollow trunk.

Shizuki scratched:

'HELLO!'

The forest immediately echoes:

'Hello... hello... hello...'

Below it:

'Regret.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap untouched and wisely avoid contributing new material
to the echo system.

right.message:
A knocking sound comes from inside one trunk.

Knock knock.

You wait.

Knock knock.

An Echo-Bark Woodfish shoots from the hollow.

Worst joke setup.

forward.message:
A shrine coffer sits inside an open trunk. Star Candies rattle inside,
and every tiny clink echoes through the forest.

echo-bark-trunks-depths.prompt: Towering kelp surrounds three passages lined with hollow echo-bark.

left.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's experiment log:

'Yelled BERRIES into tree.

Tree yelled BERRIES back.

Conducted seventeen additional tests.

Results consistent.'

right.message:
An offering basket rests beneath a trunk repeating the distant sound
of laughter from some long-gone traveler.

forward.message:
A Woodfish imitates the sound of a Berry pouch opening from inside the
trunk.

Clever.

Manipulative.

Effective.

echo-bark-trunks-threshold.prompt:
Living roots approach Hollow Song Chamber, where three enormous trunks
resonate with one another.

left.message:
A Woodfish knocks from one trunk.

Another trunk answers.

Then a third.

The actual Woodfish emerges from the fourth trunk you did not notice.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beside Shizuki's final echo test:

'I shouted HELLO.

Something very far away answered.

Test concluded.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the pool untouched and absolutely do not repeat the test.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp hides a cache inside a resonant trunk. The Star
Candies ring like tiny bells when removed.

boss-antechamber.name: Hollow Song Chamber
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every hollow trunk in the chamber produces the same deep knock.

bossPromptDiscord:
One knock rolls through Hollow Song Chamber.

Then another.

Every echo-bark trunk answers in perfect rhythm.

Something enormous moves inside the interconnected hollows.

Use /yes to enter the Chamber or /no to leave before whatever is knocking
expects an answer.
bossPromptTwitch:
One knock rolls through Hollow Song Chamber.

Then another.

Every echo-bark trunk answers in perfect rhythm.

Something enormous moves inside the interconnected hollows.

Use !yes to enter the Chamber or !no to leave before whatever is knocking
expects an answer.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat. One final knock echoes behind you.

You do not answer.

boss.revealText:
The oldest trunk splits open as a massive Woodfish surges from the
heartwood.

Resonant Timberfish reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Resonant Timberfish disappears into the hollow forest.

The echoes slowly fade.

Then, from very far away:

'BERRIES.'

Shizuki's experiment survived."
